body: So what do you propose? Just removing the file check?

Yes, since the PHP_BINARY constant specifies the PHP binary path during script execution. 
So if it set there is no need to check if the file exists because if we are using cli we already used the binary.

issue.title: Fixes #26563 (open_basedir restriction in effect)
issue.body:
If the open_basedir is set is_file(PHP_BINARY) is false.
